backing.backing_score_basis: MEASURES THE LOAN BOOK'S EVIDENCE QUALITY, NOT A COVERAGE RATIO. ⚠️ AUTHORED 2026-09-06 AT 5.5 AND RE-DERIVED THE SAME DAY TO 6.0 ON THE PegTracker RECONCILIATION — the first figures were wrong-harsh, and the correction is recorded here rather than silently applied. ⚠️ SCORED HALF A POINT BELOW syrupUSDC (6.5) ON THE SAME ARCHITECTURE: same operator, same evidence method, smaller and less seasoned book. ⚠️⚠️ THE FEED'S `collateral_ratio: 100.0` IS AN ACCOUNTING IDENTITY, NOT A SOLVENCY MEASUREMENT, AND IT IS THE MOST MISREADABLE NUMBER ON THIS ASSET. The pool's backing IS its loan book: positions enumerate to `principalOut()` with a residual of $0.00, so backing equals supply BY CONSTRUCTION and the ratio cannot print anything but ~100. The published `surplus_deficit` of $5.98 against a $368,859,875.86 book is 0.0000016% of the book — that is rounding, NOT a buffer. ⚠️ A 100.0 here carries NO information about whether the loans are good. Read it as 'the books balance', never as 'the asset is fully covered'. The solvency question lives in LOAN QUALITY and BORROWER CONCENTRATION, which is axis 4.

backing_score_change.basis: RETRACTS the same-day 6.0 -> 5.5 cut. That cut compared top-1 24.19% (on a $392,718,462 book) with 37.79% (on a $244,037,062 book) -- different denominators. The book contracted 37.9% in 18 days, verified: PoolManager.totalAssets() = $252,592,289 at block 26,046,137. The share rose because the denominator fell and because a different borrower is now largest; the former top borrower repaid ~$70M. Nobody scaled up.
backing_score_change.not_load_bearing: What IS established and unreported: the 37.9% contraction itself, borrowers 9->8, HHI 1876->2498, top-3 66.8%->80.9%, with impaired/called/default all 0. Separating concentration from contraction needs the 2026-09-06 per-borrower list, which we do not hold. Re-cut trigger: top-1 >30% / top-3 >75% across two consecutive reads whose principal is within 5%.

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: MEASURES ACCESS PATTERN AND ROUTE QUALITY, NOT POOL DEPTH. ⚠️ A FULL POINT AND A HALF BELOW syrupUSDC'S 7.5 ON THE SAME MECHANISM, and the reason is size not design: a smaller Ethereum pool TVL means higher aggregator slippage at the same notional and a longer queue cadence at institutional size. The permissionless mint/redeem advantage that lifted syrupUSDC applies here identically — it is the depth behind it that differs. ⚠️ Same normal-conditions caveat: stress-case redemption is a queue against an illiquid loan book.

dependencies.underlying_score_basis: MEASURES THE COUNTERPARTY SET — how many, how concentrated, how SUBSTITUTABLE. ⚠️⚠️ CUT 5.0 → 4.0 ON 2026-10-03 (owner ruling) AND THIS IS A BOUND, NOT A NEW MEASUREMENT: syrupUSDT's counterparty set CONTAINS usdt's, so it may not score above it, and usdt carries 4.0 for unenumerability — no full audit has ever been completed, so not one custodian or banking counterparty is nameable for a $183.64B book. syrupUSDT inherits that whole set and adds its own unenumerable one: firm is null on all nine addresses, Maple publishes no borrower identities, and collateral is held off-chain by the delegate's custodian. Two unenumerable sets stacked, so 4.0 is the CEILING. ✅ IT SITS AT THE CEILING RATHER THAN BELOW IT ON TWO MEASURED OFFSETS: ~19.74% of the book is a $50M at-par USDC position (0x1Af652b5…BAA5, position_type liquidity), so Tether is ~80% of this set and not all of it, and that fifth is Circle at axis-4 7.0; and this pool's own added legs are address-enumerable with shares measured at 100% enumeration and $0.00 residual, where usdt's cannot be named at all. Those offsets cancel the added borrower set; they do not lift it past the ceiling. ⚠️ QUALITY IS NOT THE ARGUMENT. Circle scoring 7.0 is a reason the USDT weight is ~80%, not a reason this asset scores better — a good counterparty at 100% is still 100%, and the 154.45% pool collateral ratio is a Backing fact this axis does not price. ⚠️ LIQUIDITY CUSTODY EOAs ARE SHARED WITH syrupUSDC (PYUSD + USTB + AMM), so a holder of both pools does not hold two independent positions at the custody layer. ⚠️ THE CONCENTRATION MOVE IS NOT CHARGED HERE, DELIBERATELY. Live at 2026-10-02T16:45:40Z: top-1 36.42%, top-3 77.96%, HHI 2,328 against the 24.19% / 66.77% / 1,876 the report states. A cut on those figures was taken 2026-09-24 and retracted the same day as a moved denominator; eight days on they have not reverted. Left off this cut so the bound stays reviewable, and carried to the backlog for its own ruling. ⚠️ BASIS TRAP: the $253,242,712.37 denominator includes $59,150,015 of pool-owned liquidity wrapped as loans (10 of 18 positions). On third-party credit alone ($194,092,697) the top name is 47.52%, not 36.42%.
